name: Mask-based Voxel Filtering
definition: A fragment shader that combines the original volume dataset with a texture mask (SculptMap) to discard voxels marked for removal during visualization.
summary: Mask-based Voxel Filtering is a fragment shader that combines volume data with a texture mask to discard voxels or insert material, differing from tagging shaders by performing actual visual filtering during the drawing phase.
